subject: Render milestone: v2 facts for mips/3D/array/cube/MS, n2r_build_v2 direct PASS
body:
Continued per root. Production edits remain only render_encoder.inc/render_pipeline.inc/device_limits.h.

IMPLEMENTED
- tegu_generic_v2_build: per-binding n2r_texture_binding from plan+retained TeguTexture/TeguSampler, full backing span, N2T layout, exact runtime sampler state via tegu_sampler_get_state, n2t validate/layout-check.
- Immutable v2 REFUSES explicitly (Vulkan enums + missing Metal LOD/normalized/bias/integer facts), per frontend_audit BLOCKING; one-level legacy path unchanged.
- Allocation/layout facts: usage=1 2D mip chains with 64-byte rows per level; R55 R8 3D depth/slice; shader-read usage=1/options=0 2D-array, cube, cube-array, 2D-MS, 2D-MS-array with layer-major levels and slice/layer strides. Existing usage5/private mip layouts and exact classes unchanged. CPU copies remain layer0/slice0 only.
- Direct host test PASS: 16x16 2-level BGRA8 + linear sampler -> sidecar and real n2r_build_v2 descriptor level=1/array=0; 3D depth2 slice4096/backing8192; 2D-array layers2 layer_stride1024/backing2048; cube layers6/backing6144; 4xMSAA slice1024/backing4096; immutable-v2 refusal. Existing magma/same-slot/VertexIndex/indexed/lifetime tests pass.

STILL BLOCKED ON CROSS-OWNER HOOKS (no UI reachability claimed)
1. compute: additive n2mb_draw_v2 + draw_locked sidecar parameter calling n2r_build_v2; old n2mb_draw/n2r_build bytes unchanged. I can provide the exact one-function patch.
2. Dispatch storage: a void *genericTextureSidecar field and cleanup; compositor_submit.inc passes it to n2mb_draw_v2. Root: assign compositor_submit.inc to render or have compute make the field/call. Render will allocate/copy the validated sidecar at snapshot and free on all paths.
3. compute air_bridge generic planner: mips>1 (except exact blur), array_length>1, sample_count>1 and exact view_format/compare facts still refuse. Without this, 2-level/array/MS plans stop before the sidecar even though n2r_build_v2 accepts them.
4. normal sampler factory still narrow (textures owned); exact state is available only via newSamplerStateWithExactDescriptor. Generic path now reads state exactly; no nearest substitution.

Note: compute's active compute_frontend/runtime_pipeline/pipeline_format tree is mid-edit and currently does not compile together. My host test isolates the render frontend with committed compute/runtime sources and current render/textures; production ARM64 compile is deferred to root after compute settles. No commit/phone/build.
